generations.zh: 2026-11-04 发布、2026-11-20 正式开源：770B 总参 / 49B 激活 MoE，上下文超过 100 万 token，首次加入视觉理解；权重以 Apache-2.0 在 GitHub、Hugging Face、ModelScope、GitCode 同步放出，并附 system card。
generations.en: Announced 2026-11-04 and open-sourced 2026-11-20: a 770B-total / 49B-active MoE with over one million tokens of context and first-time visual understanding; Apache-2.0 weights shipped on GitHub, Hugging Face, ModelScope and GitCode with a system card.

generations.zh: 2026-11-16 发布、2026-11-18 开源：224B 总参（含 64B Engram）、12B 激活、多模态输入、1M 上下文；官方主打高速度与低成本，开源版本含 Hy4 flash / FP8 / Base。
generations.en: Released 2026-11-16 and open-sourced 2026-11-18: 224B total parameters (including 64B Engram), 12B active, multimodal input and 1M context; pitched at high speed and low cost, with Hy4 flash / FP8 / Base in the open release.

generations.zh: 上一代预览：770B 总参 MoE、49B 激活、上下文超过 100 万 token，官方主打长程 agent、编码与办公任务；2026-08-28 开放 preview 与 FP8 权重。
generations.en: Previous preview: a 770B-total MoE with 49B active parameters and beyond one million tokens of context, positioned for long-horizon agents, coding and office work; preview and FP8 weights opened on 2026-08-28.

generations.zh: Hy3 于 2026-07 正式发布；preview 于 2026-04-23 发布并开源：295B 总参、21B 激活、最大 256K 上下文，快慢思考融合 MoE。
generations.en: Hy3 launched officially in July 2026; the preview was released and open-sourced on 2026-04-23: 295B total, 21B active, up to 256K context, a hybrid fast/slow-thinking MoE.

sizeTiers.zh: Hy4：官方发布页未披露总参 / 激活；视觉理解、长上下文与长程 agent 是重点（以模型卡为准）
sizeTiers.en: Hy4: total / active parameters not disclosed on the release page; visual understanding, long context and long-horizon agents are the focus (model card is authoritative)

sizeTiers.zh: Hy4 flash：224B 总参（含 64B Engram，12B 激活），1M 上下文
sizeTiers.en: Hy4 flash: 224B total (64B Engram included, 12B active), 1M context

sizeTiers.zh: Hy4 Preview：770B 总参 / 49B 激活（Hy4 flash 发布页的对照口径）
sizeTiers.en: Hy4 Preview: 770B total / 49B active (comparison figure in the Hy4 flash release)

sizeTiers.zh: Hy3：295B 总参（MoE，21B 激活），256K 上下文

licenses.zh: 非宽松许可：使用前须读腾讯混元发布页的许可原文，这里不解读条款。
licenses.en: Non-permissive: read the licence text on the Tencent Hunyuan release page; this site does not interpret it.

claims.zh: 腾讯官方：Hy4 于 2026-11-04 发布，首次引入视觉理解，并在指令跟随、长上下文理解与长程 agent 任务上有明显提升；官方称将随后发布模型权重与 system card。
claims.en: Tencent official: Hy4 launched on 2026-11-04, adding visual understanding for the first time and claiming clear gains in instruction following, long-context comprehension and long-horizon agentic tasks; weights and system cards were said to follow.

claims.zh: 腾讯官方：Hy4 flash 为 224B 总参（含 64B Engram）、12B 激活、多模态输入、1M 上下文；官方称其为迄今最具成本效益的 Hy 模型，并计划开源、持续迭代。
claims.en: Tencent official: Hy4 flash has 224B total parameters (including 64B Engram), 12B active, multimodal input and 1M context; the vendor calls it the most cost-effective Hy model to date and plans to open-source it with frequent iterations.

claims.zh: 腾讯官方：Hy4 preview 为 770B 总参、49B 激活、上下文超过 100 万 token，主打长程 agent、编码与办公。
claims.en: Tencent official: Hy4 preview has 770B total parameters, 49B active and a context beyond 1M tokens, pitched at long-horizon agents, coding and office work.

claims.zh: 腾讯官方：Hy3 preview 为 295B 总参、21B 激活、最大 256K 上下文，快慢思考融合 MoE。
claims.en: Tencent official: Hy3 preview has 295B total parameters, 21B active and up to 256K context, a hybrid fast/slow-thinking MoE.

positioning.zh: 中文开放权重家族里少有的「大总参 + 高激活」路线：Hy4 正式版主打视觉理解、长上下文与长程 agent，Hy4 flash 则用 224B 总参 / 12B 激活换速度与成本。正式版参数量官方未在同一页披露，站内不把 preview 的 770B/49B 直接套到正式版。这里暂时没有 GGUF 量化收录，选型前先看官方许可与硬件门槛。
positioning.en: An uncommon large-total/high-active Chinese open-weight family: production Hy4 targets visual understanding, long context and long-horizon agents, while Hy4 flash trades 224B total / 12B active for speed and cost. The production parameter count is not disclosed on the release page, so this site does not copy the preview’s 770B/49B onto it. There is no GGUF coverage yet — read the official licence and hardware floor before choosing.

onSite.zh: 这里暂时没有腾讯混元的 GGUF 量化收录（未达量化热度与可核验覆盖门槛）。
onSite.en: No GGUF coverage for Tencent Hunyuan on this site yet (below the quantisation-heat and verifiable-coverage threshold).
